text:
Emily (PM): kicking off the rollout plan for the Q2 geo-light feature flag (session-synthesis v2). goal: staged NA -> EU -> APAC, tenant opt-in for first wave.
Mike (Eng): rough plan: feature flag + A/B split. Variant B = new model + KV cache. start 5% visible -> increase to 25% if gates pass.
Sanjeev (SRE): suggest dedicated canary in eu-west with warmup instances. auto-fallback policy must be explicit (cpu, p99, error rate).
Anna (Data): metrics we need wired: per-tenant p50/p95/p99 latency, 5xx error rate, quality delta on eval set. i can produce initial eval queries.
Emily (PM): launch gates: pass at 5% (smoke), manual approval at 25%, full ramp only if no quality regression >1.5% on eval and infra alarms clear.
Mike (Eng): flag config draft (for ops-config):
```json
{"flag":"session_synth_v2","variants":[{"name":"baseline","ratio":0.95},{"name":"v2","ratio":0.05}],"targets":[{"region":"NA","cohort":"opt-in"}],"kill_switch":"global_off"}
```
Sanjeev (SRE): I'll add canary alarms: error_rate>0.5% OR p99_latency>350ms for 5m -> auto-fallback to baseline. also add throttle guard: sliding window qps cap.
deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 2026-06-01T09:00Z, warmup=true, backup_pool=baseline
Mike (Eng): recommend shadowing v2 for 10% in EU for 24h before visible split to catch regressions in eval metrics.
Anna (Data): sample sizing: aim for ~10k requests per cohort to detect ~1.5% quality delta with 95% power. i'll craft the dashboard panels: lift, p-values, bucket counts.
Emily (PM): enterprise ask: Customer X requires EU-only opt-out + per-tenant override. need opt-out flagging + audit trail.
Sanjeev (SRE): add per-tenant killpath and audit log entries; fallback policy should also include fallback to a quantized GPU variant if v2 model fails health checks.
Mike (Eng): infra action items:
- Mike: add flag schema + rollout script, implement shadow routing for EU
- Sanjeev: alarms, per-tenant killpath, maintenance window
- Anna: eval harness, dashboards, sampling queries
- Emily: customer comms + runbook
Target soft launch: 2026-06-08.
Emily (PM): any blockers? :eyes:
Mike (Eng): from eng side looks good :white_check_mark:
Sanjeev (SRE): ok from SRE, will schedule a 30m maintenance window during canary start :wrench:
Anna (Data): will have the dashboard and initial eval set by EOD tomorrow.
Emily (PM): i'll post the finalized runbook in #launchroom after infra PR merges. tagging @Mike and @Sanjeev for follow-up. thanks everyone!
